heroSummary: Olentangy Schools begins Thursday, August 20, 2026. Grades K–11 finish Thursday, May 27, while seniors finish May 14. Kindergarten and preschool follow separate attendance schedules, so families in those programs should also check the official companion calendars below. The May 27 two-hour early dismissal applies only to grades K–5.
heroSourceLine: 2026–27 District Calendar · Companion Kindergarten, Preschool, and School Events calendars reviewed
verificationBadgeText: Four official one-page calendars visually reviewed
calendarNotes: August 20 is the first day for most K–12 students, but one kindergarten cohort begins August 21. Preschool starts August 25 and generally meets Tuesday through Friday. Families in either program should use the official companion calendar for their child's attendance dates. September 21, October 16, November 25 and 30, January 4, February 12, March 12 and 26, and May 28 are staff or conference-exchange dates with no school for students. Winter Break runs December 21 through January 1; January 4 is a teacher workday, so students return January 5. Spring Break runs March 29 through April 2, after a Conference Exchange Day on March 26. Seniors finish May 14, high school graduations are May 16, preschool ends May 26, and grades K–11 finish May 27. The May 27 two-hour early dismissal applies only to grades K–5.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Olentangy Schools start in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: K–12 begins Thursday, August 20, 2026. The Monday/Thursday kindergarten cohort starts that day, the Tuesday/Friday cohort starts August 21, and preschool starts August 25.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Olentangy Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Students are out beginning December 21, 2026. January 4, 2027 is a teacher workday, and classes resume January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Olentangy Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 29 through Friday, April 2, 2027. Students also have no school Friday, March 26 for a Conference Exchange Day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of Olentangy school in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades K–11 finish Thursday, May 27, 2027, with a two-hour early dismissal for grades K–5. Seniors finish May 14 and preschool ends May 26 without early release.

calendarFaqs.q: How does the Olentangy kindergarten calendar work?
calendarFaqs.a: One color cohort attends Monday and Thursday, the other attends Tuesday and Friday, and the official calendar assigns Wednesdays by color. Families should use the cohort provided by their school.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Olentangy preschool follow the K–12 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: It shares many district closures but has its own Tuesday–Friday attendance pattern, first and last dates, conferences, and program events. Use the Preschool Calendar for your child's attendance dates.

calendarFaqs.q: When are Olentangy high school graduations in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: All four are scheduled May 16: Olentangy at 9:00 a.m., Liberty at noon, Orange at 3:00 p.m., and Berlin at 6:00 p.m. Confirm venue and arrival instructions with the high school.
